A '''[[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] cutter''' was a state-of-the-art [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with advanced [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] systems. The ''[[Iopene Princess]]'' was one of such starships.<ref name="EV" />
